lines.en: The hawk-eagle takes two steps along the branch.
Its talons hook the bark securely.
Its crest feathers sway as it moves.

lines.zh: 它从一根枝跳到另一根
lines.en: It hops from one branch to the next.
It lands high and scans the wood.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀半张，保持平衡
lines.en: Wings half open to balance.
The bars across its breast are clear.
It cocks its head and stares down.

lines.zh: 它在枝间挪到更好的位置
lines.en: It shifts along to a better perch.
One light hop, and it lands true.
Its tail feathers dip slightly.
It works along the canopy edge.
The hawk-eagle stands still on a dead branch.
It folds its wings and breathes slowly.
It lifts a talon and sets it down.
It ruffles its feathers out.
It listens to movement below.
Its eyes hardly move.
It turns its head through a wide arc.
Its tail bobs lightly.
Its crest lies flat.

lines.zh: 它仰头看一只飞过的鸟
lines.en: It tilts up at a passing bird.

lines.zh: 它打了个小喷嚏，抖了下头
lines.en: It sneezes and shakes its head.
It hones its talons on the branch.
It suddenly dips its head to its breast.

lines.zh: 它看上去像一段立着的树枝
lines.en: It looks like a standing piece of branch.
The hawk-eagle looks down at you.

lines.zh: 它的头侧过去，一只眼看你
lines.en: It cocks its head, one eye on you.
Its crest rises slowly.
It turns its body toward you.
Its talons tighten on the branch.
Its gaze never wanders.

lines.zh: 它掂量了一下你的体型
lines.en: It sizes up your build.
It half opens its wings and folds them.

lines.zh: 它低头看了看自己的爪
lines.en: It glances at its own talons.
It gives a short, sharp call.
It edges half a foot sideways.

lines.zh: 它似乎对你失去了兴趣
lines.en: It seems to lose interest in you.
It turns back to watching the wood.
It drops forward as if to fall.

lines.zh: 但它只是换了个更低的枝
lines.en: But it only takes a lower branch.
Now it is much closer.

lines.zh: 它的影子才刚落到你脚边
lines.en: Its shadow has only reached your feet.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的手上有没有东西
lines.en: It watches your hands for something.
Hurt, the hawk-eagle flaps away.
A few feathers spiral down.

lines.zh: 它落地后单脚站了一会
lines.en: It lands and stands on one leg a while.
It opens its beak in a sharp cry.
One wing hangs crooked.
It retreats behind a branch, head out.

lines.zh: 它抖了抖身体，羽毛归位
lines.en: It shakes and its feathers settle.

lines.zh: 它侧目看伤口，很快抬头
lines.en: It eyes the wound, then looks up fast.
Its breast heaves with breath.
It does not leave; it grows warier.
The hawk-eagle fixes on the meat.
It leans forward, wings half spread.

lines.zh: 它落下来，落在你几步外
lines.en: It drops and lands a few paces off.
It approaches side-on, wary.
A talon pins it and it tears in.
It wrenches the meat with its head.
It swallows fast, throat working.
Done, it looks up for more.
It calls, sharply.

lines.zh: 它跳上你的手臂那么高的枝
lines.en: It hops to a branch at arm's height.
Bumped, the hawk-eagle flaps clear.

lines.zh: 它落地时翅膀张得很开
lines.en: It lands with wings spread wide.

lines.zh: 它的爪在你肩头抓了一下
lines.en: Its talons rake your shoulder.

lines.zh: 它侧身滑过，风扫到你脸上
lines.en: It slips past and the wind hits your face.
It settles on the ground beside you.
It looks up at you, unruffled.
It backs two steps, crest up.
Feathers brush the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 它拍了下翅膀，稳住身体
lines.en: A wingbeat rights it.

lines.zh: 它重新站直，像什么都没发生
lines.en: It straightens as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 两只鹰雕并排立在枝上
lines.en: Two hawk-eagles perch side by side.
They turn their heads to each other.

lines.zh: 一只替另一只理了理颈羽
lines.en: One preens the other's neck.

lines.zh: 它们同时起落，像照镜子
lines.en: They move as one, like a mirror.
Their calls rise and answer.
They look down over the wood together.

lines.zh: 一只靠近，另一只让了让
lines.en: One comes close; the other shifts over.

lines.zh: 它们的翅膀几乎挨在一起
lines.en: Their wings almost touch.
They are a quiet pair.
The perch stays quiet a long while.
The hawk-eagle grips the meat.
It picks it up and gives it a shake.
It pins the item to the branch and tears.

lines.zh: 它用喙挑出能吃的部分
lines.en: Its beak picks out the edible parts.
What is left, it drops.

lines.zh: 它把东西带到更高的枝
lines.en: It carries it to a higher branch.
It wedges the meat in a fork.
It wipes its beak clean.

lines.zh: 它飞下来捡走了落下的那块
lines.en: It flies down for the dropped piece.

lines.zh: 拿到东西后它立刻升空
lines.en: Prize taken, it climbs at once.
The hawk-eagle's crest flares.

lines.zh: 它俯下身，翅膀张到一半
lines.en: It crouches, wings half open.
Its eyes lock onto you.
Talons scrape the branch.

lines.zh: 它发出短促尖利的一声
lines.en: It gives one sharp cry.
Its tail dips for a dive.

lines.zh: 它把你从周围分了出来
lines.en: It has singled you out.
It starts working along the branch.
Its head drops below its shoulders.
Air begins to move under its wings.
It has confirmed the range.
Then the whole body tips forward.

lines.zh: 地上多了一道掠过的影
lines.en: A shadow sweeps across the ground.
It has left the branch.
It will not change course now.

lines.zh: 你听见翅膀劈开空气的声音
lines.en: You hear wings cut the air.
The hawk-eagle circles overhead.
Each circle drops lower.

lines.zh: 它在等一个背对你的时机
lines.en: It waits for your back to turn.
Following the shadow, I found you.
It lands in a tree, changes perch.
And takes off again.
It dives and pulls up.
That was only a test.
Its talons pass above you.
The wind scatters your hair.
Eagle feathers trail behind me.
Its eyes never look elsewhere.
It much prefers the high angle.
It glides with barely a wingbeat.

lines.zh: 它把高度压到了树冠下
lines.en: It drops below the canopy.

lines.zh: 它已经把你圈进了弧线里
lines.en: It has folded you into its arc.
Suddenly it hovers in place.
That hover is the last preparation.
The hawk-eagle dives, talons first.

lines.zh: 它的爪抓在你肩甲上打滑
lines.en: Its talons slip off your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 它掠过时翅膀扇到你脸
lines.en: Its wing fans your face as it passes.
Its beak jabs the back of your hand.
Missing, it pulls up at once.
The second dive is steeper.

lines.zh: 它抓住你的衣袖往上扯
lines.en: It grips your sleeve and hauls.

lines.zh: 它的爪尖在护甲上刮出白痕
lines.en: Claw tips score white lines on your armour.

lines.zh: 它从侧面切入，避开你的手
lines.en: It cuts in from the side, clear of your hands.

lines.zh: 它落地后再起飞，更快了
lines.en: It lands and launches again, faster.

lines.zh: 它的尾羽在急转时张开
lines.en: Its tail flares in the turn.

lines.zh: 它低低地掠过你的头顶
lines.en: It skims low over your head.
A talon shoves your arm aside.
Done, it returns high and pants.
It settles and its crest eases.

lines.zh: 它在等下一次更好的角度
lines.en: It waits for a better angle.
The canopy rustles.
The hawk-eagle drops through the leaves.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀一张就停住了
lines.en: One wingbeat and it stops.

lines.zh: 它立在低枝上，冠羽竖着
lines.en: It perches low, crest raised.
Its talons bite the bark.
Dust drifts off its feathers.
It first scans the whole wood.

lines.zh: 然后才把注意力放到你身上
lines.en: Only then does it attend to you.
One call, and the wood goes quiet.
It fluffs out its breast feathers.
It works its way down branch by branch.
At last it lands on a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 它的影子正好落在你脚前
lines.en: Its shadow lands right before your feet.

lines.zh: 它歪着头，看你要做什么
lines.en: It tilts its head to see what you do.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸很稳，翅尖微颤
lines.en: Its breathing is steady, wingtips quivering.

lines.zh: 它把一只爪换了个位置
lines.en: It shifts one talon's grip.

lines.zh: 它看起来完全不像害怕
lines.en: It does not look frightened at all.

lines.zh: 它把这棵树当成了自己的
lines.en: It treats this tree as its own.

lines.zh: 羽毛被燎焦，它惊得腾空
lines.en: Singed feathers launch it into the air.
It lands and tips onto its side.
Soaked wings beat uselessly at the water.

lines.zh: 冲击把它掀得翻滚出去
lines.en: The blast throws it tumbling.

lines.zh: 箭穿过翼羽，它叫了一声
lines.en: An arrow passes through a wing; it cries out.
Odd force jolts its whole frame.
Starving thin, its flight goes unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷击让它僵在半空，直落
lines.en: Lightning locks it midair; it drops.
The void pulls; it beats its wings hard.
